findings.summary: userShape schema is declared `const` (un-exported); only the inferred `User` type is exported — downstream modules cannot compose/extend the schema
findings.suggested_fix: Either export userShape (rename e.g. `userSchema`) so api/ui can reuse it for validation/composition, or accept type-only export as a deliberate API surface choice.

findings.summary: No `scripts.typecheck` declared; root `pnpm -r typecheck` will silently skip this package (and any tsc errors here go unobserved)
findings.suggested_fix: Add `"scripts": { "typecheck": "tsc -p tsconfig.json" }` so root `-r typecheck` exercises the contracts package.
